svg.title: Class diagram: What makes up the scanner?
svg.desc: UML class diagram of the Aegis Sentinel scanner: the RansomwareScanner facade and its five mixins, the layer pipeline, scoring, the isolated-scan classes, the detection engines and the external-service clients.

g.text: Detection engines: one attribute each, created in RansomwareScanner.__init__()
QRScanner, MLClassifier and ScriptEmulator are optional (0..1).
Callers: the classes that start a scan
_ScanService owns a scanner; FolderMonitor and MailboxScanner keep a reference; ScanController receives one per call.
A diamond line that ends at a
to each class in that frame.
one composition per class in the frame
Class diagram: What makes up the scanner?
The classes on the scan path, with their names in the code. Branch review/production-hardening, commit f825915.
